daily.title: Breaking: Boy, 11, dies days after being shot in the head at Sydney home
daily.summary: An 11-year-old boy has died several days after he was shot in the head at a home in Sydney's north-west.

daily.title: Far-right UK activist arrested after 'slashing migrant boat' at sea
daily.summary: British far-right activist Daniel Thomas is arrested for allegedly using a knife to slash an inflatable dinghy being used by migrants trying to cross the English Channel.

daily.title: Police investigate fatal Frankston fire
daily.summary: Police say a woman was found dead inside a home in Melbourne's south-east on Thursday afternoon.

daily.title: Former suburban Melbourne mayor jailed for sexually assaulting teenager
daily.summary: Former Moonee Valley mayor Cam Nation has been handed a three-month jail sentence for sexually assaulting a teenage boy.

daily.title: Australia calls for 'absolute consensus' on Pacific military group
daily.summary: Pacific defence ministers signal they will not rush to expand the remit of a new military response group, with Australia's defence chief saying there must be "absolute consensus" about how it evolves.

daily.title: Second child dies after Blue Mountains stabbing, third child still critical
daily.summary: A second child has died after a mother stabbed her three children in the Blue Mountains on the weekend.

daily.title: Brethren members campaigned across NT during 2025 election, inquiry hears
daily.summary: Former senior Northern Territory Labor politicians have claimed members of the Plymouth Brethren Christian Church — also known as the Exclusive Brethren — helped campaign for the Country Liberal Party ahead of the 2025 federal election.

daily.title: Corruption watchdog strengthened on final day of Victorian parliament
daily.summary: Victoria's IBAC will be able to follow financial trails and crack down on "grey corruption" under the new laws.

daily.title: Western Power employees sacked for backing rapist
daily.summary: Three Western Power employees who provided a character reference for a colleague convicted of rape are sacked after an external investigation.

daily.title: Spiritual group used follower's loans on 'luxury' trip and property, court hears
daily.summary: A spiritual group based in northern NSW has rejected claims it is liable to repay loans from a former follower who is suing for $2.55 million.

daily.title: Collapsed caravan company referred to ASIC amid $9 million debt
daily.summary: A creditors' meeting for Australian Off Road, which collapsed last week, reveals the caravan maker owes about $9 million.

daily.title: Magistrate livid as child protection staff fail to turn up for 14yo in court
daily.summary: A regional magistrate says she will lodge a complaint against WA's Child Protection staff after a teenager in their care was left to appear alone in court.

daily.title: Legal action lodged over SA government’s MotoGP circuit plans
daily.summary: Designs for the $96 million street circuit, which will require the removal of nearly 400 trees from the eastern parklands, were released in August.

daily.title: 'Catastrophic failure': Cheryl Grimmer family gives Premier deadline
daily.summary: Cheryl Grimmer's family has given the premier until September 29 to review the abandoned murder case or face a parliamentary push for government records.

daily.title: Lenders pull out of Bathla group as construction work halts across sites
daily.summary: Building work has stopped at sites and company is down to skeleton staff.

daily.title: Self-described 'evil' man avoids jail for wire traps on bike path
daily.summary: Levi Young-Henderson, 20, receives a suspended sentence for setting wire traps on an Adelaide bike path in 2025.

daily.title: Man arrested over early morning police pursuit with large sword in car
daily.summary: A 22-year-old man is arrested after leading police on a high speed pursuit, crossing the ACT-NSW border four times with a large sword, a flick knife, and balaclavas in the car.

daily.title: Woman dead, two seriously injured after Yarra Ranges bus crash
daily.summary: A woman has died and multiple people injured after a bus and two cars collided on a dangerous stretch of highway north-east of Melbourne.

daily.title: Albanese couldn't have timed his Medicare hack bombshell better
daily.summary: Anthony Albanese couldn't have picked a better time to drop the metaphorical bomb that a rogue artificial intelligence agent breached an Australian government system.

daily.title: Cold case murder trial witness admits lying to police
daily.summary: The jury in a cold case murder trial over the disappearance of a Victorian man in 2006 has heard a key witness admit they had lied to police.

daily.title: Judge orders reversal of Trump's White House media ban
daily.summary: A federal judge has ordered US President Donald Trump to restore White House access for journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico.

daily.title: 'Heed the warning': NSW premier urges caution with AI after data breach
daily.summary: The NSW premier has urged the world to listen to the warnings of artificial intelligence bosses about the technology's potential dangers, after a state dataset found it could be vulnerable to exploitation.

daily.title: 'Sudden' death of SA woman from falling tree branch preventable, coroner finds
daily.summary: South Australian school teacher Judith Anne Ditter died in November 2020 when a heavy branch hit a car she was travelling in on an Adelaide Hills road.

daily.title: Couple sentenced to 13 years' jail over $121 million cocaine yacht haul
daily.summary: The court heard the men travelled to Townsville and used a drill to access the hull of yacht docked in the marina that was concealing hundreds of packages of cocaine.

daily.title: Winx's $10m daughter starts breeding career, champion mare foals again
daily.summary: Champion racemare Winx welcomes a third healthy foal as her first, $10-million daughter Quinceanera, begins her breeding career this season.

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
developing.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.title: Live: RBA more likely to raise rates as US Federal Reserve lifts to 4pc
developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.title: Live: Labor folds to pressure, scraps $5,000 veterans allied health cap
developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
developing.summary: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Minister won't say if migration shake-up has undergone economic modelling
developing.summary: Amanda Rishworth has sidestepped questions about whether the government has undertaken economic modelling of its migration changes. Follow live.
